evidence.scope: Full screen cell grid except the final two environment-dependent working-directory and usage footer rows.

Attributes on identical stock/themed screen rows, with SGR state carried across line boundaries. Cells the tool and working-indicator adapters restyle to their documented colors are excluded here and verified by the adapter property tests and surface observations.

Stock RGB values map to the corresponding target role colors on identical screen rows. Shared stock role colors allow each corresponding target color; unchanged colors are allowed for fixed Pi branding.

evidence.manual: tmux-driven resize (SIGWINCH redraw, not a GUI drag) of a session with a 4-change edit diff: 120 -> 40 -> 60 -> 160 -> 120 columns, captured with capture-pane -N, with the package loaded by -e extensions/index.ts and --theme themes/claude-default-dark.json. scripts/resize-check.ts: at every width each diff row (9, or 11 when wrapped at 40) is painted from column 1 to width-2 with no gaps and nothing painted outside the rows; the frame after returning to 120 is byte-identical to the first. Earlier (2026-11-13) the user resized Alacritty itself across three widths with a Markdown diff and saw no leftover colored cells. Not covered: Alacritty reflowing its own scrollback.
evidence.automated: Fixed-width captures do not exercise a mid-session resize and terminal redraw.
